name: hermes-tv-tizen
description: HermesTV Tizen .wgt build pipeline — produces a sideloadable package from the hermes-web-tv Vite build

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run prebuild && npm run build:wgt

_note: build:web compiles the source-of-truth React app. prebuild stages it into dist/ with config.xml + icon. build:wgt invokes the Tizen CLI to produce dist-tizen/HermesTV-0.1.0.wgt.
